import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"].copy()
    queries = inputs["asof_queries"].copy()

    # Ensure date-like columns are proper datetime for correct comparison,
    # while preserving NaT semantics for open-ended (current) rows.
    for col in ["eff_start_date", "eff_end_date"]:
        if col in hist.columns:
            hist[col] = pd.to_datetime(hist[col], errors="coerce")

    if "as_of_date" in queries.columns:
        queries["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(queries["as_of_date"], errors="coerce")

    # Inner join on emp_id (cartesian product of matching employee rows),
    # then filter by the half-open interval condition.
    merged = queries.merge(hist, on="emp_id", how="inner", suffixes=("", "_h"))

    start_ok = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    end_ok = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    cond = start_ok & end_ok

    result = merged.loc[cond, ["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"asof_result": result}
